pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots. Stats match diamond armor. Compatible with smithing template trims.

Total defense: 20. Toughness: 2.0. Enchantability: 10.

Repair: prismarine shards or nautilus shells.

pages.title: How to Obtain
pages.text:
No crafting recipe. Found only in Buried Treasure:
• 91% chance to appear
• Two non-duplicate pieces per chest
• Random durability, 50% chance of random enchantment

pages.title: Set Effects
pages.text:
Surf Boots: walk/run/jump on water. Sneak to sink. Fall damage negated on water.
Current Helmet: infinite Water Breathing.
Abyssal Chestplate: clear underwater vision (night vision).
Tide Leggings: increased swim speed. If you are NOT wearing Surf Boots, the leggings have an extra trick:

pages.title: Tide Leggings: Water Clutch
pages.text:
While wearing Tide Leggings and **not** wearing Surf Boots, when you:
• are holding Sneak (Shift) to crouch
• have a fall distance over 3.5 blocks (about to take fall damage)

the leggings automatically place a water source beneath your feet, so you land safely without injury; the water disappears once you are safe.

Each clutch trigger costs 1 durability on the leggings.

**Tip:** Keep holding Shift while falling from high up and the leggings will keep cushioning you all the way down.

pages.title: Full Set & Sea Doll
pages.text:
Full set: permanent Resistance II.
Sea Doll: each piece worn adds 10% damage taken (40% total for 4 pieces).
